verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a GitHub integration, repository sync, or any two-way flow of changes between Floot and a user's own Git repository. The only related capability is a one-way code and database export for self-hosting. That is an adjacent feature, not the bidirectional GitHub sync this story asks for, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync my project to my own GitHub repository and keep changes flowing both ways
